purpose_context: The webview-shell-foundation mission proved the production MIXER renders from the canonical semantic view model in a fraction of the egui layer's code. This mission completes the pivot: PATCH and every shipped surface move to the webview shell, all retained live demo scenes re-run through it with refreshed hardware evidence, the egui visual layer and its dependencies are deleted, and the crest-spec records the retirement deliberately. Phase 5 and later phases then build on one renderer instead of two.
purpose_tldr: Render every shell surface through the Tauri webview and retire the egui visual layer before Phase 5
